passage.title: Model paragraph written for TGA
paras: Priestley presents the younger generation as the play's hope, because they can still be changed by the truth. [AO1 argument] When Sheila insists that 'these girls aren't cheap labour' but 'people', [AO2 reference] the plain noun 'people' rejects her father's language of profit. [AO2 zoom] By contrast, her parents end the play relieved, as if nothing has happened; [AO1 whole-text] Priestley's structure leaves the final phone call to test who has learned. [AO2 structure]
